headword: {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}
gloss: customer service; customer support; dealing with clients

definitions.gloss: customer service; customer support; dealing with clients
definitions.explanation: the process of handling customer inquiries, complaints, and requests

examples.japanese: {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}の{研修|けんしゅう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received training in customer service.

examples.japanese: {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}が{丁寧|ていねい}な{会社|かいしゃ}は{信頼|しんらい}される。
examples.english: Companies with polite customer service earn trust.

examples.japanese: クレームの{顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}に{追|お}われて、{今日|きょう}は{一日中|いちにちじゅう}{忙|いそが}しかった。
examples.english: I was busy all day dealing with customer complaints.

notes:
Composed of {顧客|こきゃく} (customer, client) + {対応|たいおう} (handling, dealing with). A standard business term for the function of attending to customers' needs, whether in person, by phone, or online.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}の{質|しつ}: quality of customer service
- {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}{窓口|まどぐち}: customer service counter/desk
- {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}マニュアル: customer service manual
- {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}に{当|あ}たる: to handle customer service
- {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}{力|りょく}: customer service ability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {接客|せっきゃく}: customer service — emphasizes face-to-face interaction with customers
- カスタマーサポート: customer support — the loanword equivalent, used mainly in tech/online contexts
- {客|きゃく}{対応|たいおう}: guest/customer handling — more casual version
- {苦情|くじょう}{対応|たいおう}: complaint handling — specifically dealing with complaints
